input.quote: (a) Assignment. Except as stated in Sections 5.3, 7.4 and 7.6, this Agreement may not be assigned by the Depositor or the Servicer without the consent of the Owner Trustee, the Indenture Trustee, the Certificateholders and the Noteholders of at least 66-2/3% of the Note Balance of the Controlling Class.
input.rationale: Section 10.2(a) conditions assignment on consent of the Owner Trustee, Indenture Trustee, Certificateholders and Controlling Class Noteholders, but not of the Issuer or Depositor, and it carries no reasonableness standard; and the carve-out for Section 7.6 lets the Servicer assign the Agreement outright to any Affiliate of Cellco (clause (d)) with no consent from us at all. That fails the fallback (no "not unreasonably withheld" standard, and a retained no-consent affiliate assignment route) and the preferred position. Our own side is already well placed: Section 5.3 gives the Depositor successor status on merger, consolidation, succession to its business or assignment to an Affiliate, and Section 7.1 permits the Servicer to resign only if it is legally unable to perform, so no Servicer exit is triggered by a change of control on our side. The edit therefore only tightens the Servicer's side — Issuer consent (not unreasonably withheld) plus a competitor bar — and leaves Section 5.3 untouched. No competitor definition is added; the term is used in its ordinary sense, which we consider sufficient here.

mappings.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.
mappings.quote: (d) that is an Affiliate of the Depositor to whom the Depositor has assigned this Agreement, will be the successor to the Depositor under this Agreement.

mappings.element: Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.
mappings.quote: The Servicer will not resign as Servicer under this Agreement unless it determines it is legally unable to perform its obligations under this Agreement.

proposal.summary: Require Issuer consent (not unreasonably withheld) for any Servicer assignment, including the Section 7.6(d) Affiliate route, and bar assignment to a competitor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added the Issuer's consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, to any assignment by the Servicer (including the Affiliate route in clause (d) of Section 7.6) and barred assignment to a competitor of the Issuer or the Depositor. The Depositor's own affiliate and successor freedom under Section 5.3 is left intact.
